about: The kinds registry's own cases: the file the contract examples run through parseContractText, with every refusal and the line it was raised, in the set's fixture-cases style.

cases.name: the set-out stages and kinds
cases.text:
contract: 1
stages:
  - id: idea
  - id: requirements
  - id: design
  - id: build
  - id: verify
  - id: release
  - id: operate
kinds:
  - name: source
    prefix: S
    folder: docs/sources
    stage: idea
    hint: have the first conversation with a customer, write it down
  - name: hypothesis
    prefix: H
    folder: docs/hypotheses
    stage: idea
    hint: turn a source into one checkable sentence
  - name: product requirement
    prefix: FR
    folder: docs/requirements
    stage: requirements
    hint: write what the product does, one requirement at a time
  - name: decision
    prefix: D
    folder: docs/decisions
    stage: design
    hint: record the choice between the options on the table

cases.name: reserved-storage-forms-and-goals-are-read-and-named
cases.text:
contract: 1
stages:
  - id: idea
  - id: operate
kinds:
  - name: user story
    prefix: US
    folder: docs/stories
    stage: idea
    hint: one
  - name: configuration item
    prefix: CI
    folder: docs/configuration
    stage: operate
    storage: fact
    hint: keep what the system holds
    evidence:
      source: Source
      ref: Ref
      record: Record
goals:

    perspective: business
    rules:
      - every use case links a user story

reservations.message: the kind "configuration item" declares the storage form "fact"
